answer: An hostile operator running 50 aliases therefore needs 68 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in spiral, expire in summit, and ivory lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2744 identities would post 4510 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
